productDescription.description: A description of the product or service and any relevant details on how this was presented to the customer at the time of purchase.

refundPolicy.description: Token of the file upload. The merchant’s refund policy, as shown or provided to the customer.

refundPolicyDisclosure.description: An explanation of how and when the customer was shown or provided with the merchant’s refund policy prior to purchase.

refundRefusalExplanation.description: The merchant’s explanation for why the customer is not entitled to a refund.

shippingDocumentation.description: Token of the file upload. A shipping label or receipt for the disputed payment.

shippingAddress.description: The address to which a physical product was shipped.

shippingDate.description: In cases of physical products, the date that a physical product began its route to the shipping address in a clear human-readable format. This date should be prior to the date of the dispute.

shippingCarrier.description: In cases of physical products, the delivery service that shipped a physical product, such as Fedex, UPS, USPS, etc. If multiple carriers were used for this purchase, separate them with commas.

shippingTrackingNumber.description: The tracking number for a physical product, obtained from the delivery service.

uncategorizedFile.description: Token of the file upload. Additional file that’s not in any of the categories above.

uncategorizedText.description: Any additional text deemed relevant by the merchant.
